content.title: How to watch NBA on Prime Video
content.text: Welcome to the NBA Help HubAmazon Prime members enjoy live sports on Prime Video.Where to watchAmazon Prime members can watch on Amazon devices such as the Fire TV and Fire tablet, connected TVs, web browsers, and on more than 650 connected devices via the Prime Video app.On a smart TVWatch on a smart TV with the Prime Video App. View supported TVs below.Supported smart TV’sOn the webWatch in your browser. Make sure you have the latest version of a compatible browser.Compatible browsersOn an Amazon DeviceLive stream on an Amazon Device such as an Echo Show, Fire TV/Stick or a Fire Tablet.Supported Amazon DevicesOn a mobile deviceWatch on a mobile device with the Prime Video App for Android, iOS, and Windows.Supported mobile devicesExperiencing issues?Here are some possible solutions for streaming issuesCheck your internet speedCheck your bandwidth. Many speed tests are available on the internet. Prime Video serves the best video quality based on speed.Bandwidth required for video quality1 Mbps = SD Quality5 Mbps = HD QualityWatch on a supported deviceMake sure you are watching on a supported device. Older devices may struggle with higher quality streams.Check wifi signalCheck your wifi connectivity. You can check connectivity for Amazon Devices in the Alexa app or from your Devices page on amazon.comEnjoy the game your wayWatch videos to help you troubleshoot and explore features.Before the gameHow to watch live events on Prime VideoLive events will appear on the Prime Video website and Prime Video apps.Before the gameInstall Prime Video on your DevicesThe Prime Video app is available on a range of televisions, Amazon devices, mobile devices, and streaming media devices.During the gameFix Issues with Live Streams on Prime VideoWhat to do if you’re having problems watching live streams or events on Prime Video.During the gamePrime Video Live Event FeaturesPrime Video live events utilize a wide range of features to enhance your viewing experienceFrequently asked questionsAccount and AccessNBA on Prime will feature 67 exclusive games during the regular season, including an opening-week doubleheader, a new Black Friday doubleheader, and all knockout round games from the Emirates NBA Cup. It also has every game of the SoFi NBA Play-In Tournament, and select first- and second-round NBA Playoff games.Prime members in the US can watch NBA on Prime Video for no additional fees.It’s easy to find — go to the Prime Video app on your TV, computer, or mobile device, and you’ll see games on your homepage in Sports carousels, the Sports page, or the NBA League page. You can also search NBA, team names, or a specific game.Live sports are available on Amazon devices such as the Fire TV and Fire tablet, connected TVs, web browsers, and on more than 650 connected devices via the Prime Video app. Click here to see the full list of supported devices.The Prime Video app is available on a range of televisions, Amazon devices, mobile devices, Blu-ray players, games consoles, and streaming media devices. Open the app store on your device. Search for "Prime Video". Press the "Download" and/or "Install" buttons to install the app. On some devices released prior to 2020, you will be able to watch NBA on Prime but may not be able to access all advanced features. If you experience issues, you can either try another supported device or get a new device like the Fire TV Stick 4K.Prime members in the US can watch NBA on Prime within the U.S. The U.S. territories included are Puerto Rico, Guam, U.S. Virgin Islands, Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, and U.S. Minor Outlying Islands.Yes, coverage of NBA on Prime will be available in many bars and restaurants across the country. Please check with your local bars and restaurants as availability may vary.Along with the main NBA on Prime broadcast, there will be a full Spanish commentary broadcast. Additionally, Prime Video offers Multiview, which allows you to watch multiple games at once on the same screen via your Prime or League Pass subscriptions.NBA on Prime will feature English and Spanish speaking broadcasts.NBA on Prime includes game recaps, highlights, and on-demand replays of each full broadcast immediately after the game for 72 hours. Additionally, League Pass subscribers will have access to 8-12 minute condensed replays of each League Pass game.On Prime Video, you can view up to three different streams at once using the same Amazon account. You can also view the same stream simultaneously on two different devices. Additionally, Prime members will have access to multiview, which allows multiple games to be viewed on the same screen.In addition to NBA on Prime, there is a wide variety of basketball content available on Prime Video, depending on your location, including WNBA game of the week, 40 NBA G League games (and 4 G League playoff games), the ability to subscribe to NBA League Pass, as well as a variety of Amazon original documentaries such as Giannis: The Marvelous Journey.Experience an incredible day of live sports this Black Friday on Prime Video with a quadruple-header of live action. The lineup tees off at 9 a.m. ET with the anticipated return of The Capital One Skins Game golf event. The excitement continues with the third annual Black Friday Football game as the Chicago Bears take on the Philadelphia Eagles, with pregame coverage starting at 1:30 PM ET and kick off at 3:00 PM ET. The day culminates with an Emirates NBA Cup doubleheader, featuring the Milwaukee Bucks against the New York Knicks at 7:30 PM ET, followed by a west coast battle between the Dallas Mavericks and Los Angeles Lakers at 10 PM ET.No Prime membership is required—simply sign in with your free Amazon account to watchFeatures and TroubleshootingYou can turn Subtitles on or off by selecting the "CC" icon in your playback controls. For some devices, the Subtitles icon looks like a dialogue box, or it may be listed as a menu option under "Subtitles" on the video's detail page.Rewind, pause and fast forward functions are available for Android/iOS Mobile, Web (Chrome, Firefox, Edge), Fire TV, Apple TV (Gen 3 and latest) and select Smart TVs.Multiview allows you to watch multiple live sports streams simultaneously on one screen. When watching any live event stream, simply select Multiview from available features within the stream and then choose from available streaming events to add to your Multiview window.Bet Tracking creates an enhanced experience on Prime Video Sports where customers can monitor live odds, popular bets, and track their own bets along side the broadcast. For more information, see the Sports Betting FAQ here.The Sports Favorites feature lets you select your favorite sports leagues, teams and players right in the Prime Video app. Once you've selected your favorites, you will benefit from a personalized sports page and notifications whenever your team or league is playing a live game. Check your device’s available bandwidth speed. For the best live streaming experience, we recommend using a Fire TV, or a supported device with a minimum download speed of 1 Mbps for SD and 5 Mbps for HD. If you’re experiencing issues with choppy video, we recommend turning the Motion setting on your TV to Off. This setting’s name might be different depending on your TV manufacturer. Some examples of the Motion setting include Auto Motion Plus, Tru Motion, MotionFlow, Cinemotion, and Motion Picture. First, try exiting and re-entering the game stream. If you continue to have issues, please contact us.You can get support from other fans via our Amazon forums here, or for further help, please contact us via chat or phone.Still need help?Amazon NBA CommunityGet answers to your questions about Prime Live Events, Amazon devices, and more.Chat with usAmazon Customer Service will help resolve issues or answer additional questions.Have us call youAmazon Customer Service will call you right away.
